extract.description:
Extract selects which columns are read from the source. Defaults to
all columns when unset.

compare.description:
Compare selects which columns participate in change detection (drift
and history comparisons). Defaults to all extracted columns when unset.

expose.description:
Expose selects which columns are surfaced in the bridge view. Defaults
to all extracted columns when unset.

config.description: Config holds per-column bridge-view overrides, keyed by source column name.

ColumnAxes.description: Per-column configuration for an object: the extract/compare/expose glob axes plus per-column bridge-view overrides.
ColumnAxes.x-example-yaml:
extract:
  exclude: ["_raw_blob"]         # never read this column from the source
compare:
  exclude: ["updated_at"]        # ignore this column when detecting changes
expose:
  include: ["order_id", "total"] # only these appear in the bridge view
config:
  total:
    transform: "value / 100"     # SQL expression; "value" = the source column
    target: totalDollars         # rename in the bridge view

target.description: Target column name in the bridge VIEW. Defaults to the source column when empty.

bridge.description: Bridge controls whether the column appears in the bridge VIEW. Default: true.

transform.description:
Transform is a SQL expression for the bridge VIEW SELECT list;
"value" is the placeholder for the source column reference.

ColumnConfig.description: Per-column bridge-VIEW configuration (keyed by the source column name in ColumnAxes.config).

include.description:
Include lists glob patterns for column names to select. Defaults to
["*"] (all columns) when empty.

exclude.description: Exclude lists glob patterns for column names to drop, applied after Include.

ColumnSelector.description: An include/exclude glob-list over column names.

property.description:
The name of the key. Names should be in camel case–the same as if they were permanent
properties in the contract.

CustomProperty.description: A list of key/value pairs for custom properties.

enabled.description: Enabled turns dbt emission on. Off by default: a project that omits the dbt key gets no dbt directory.

path.description: Path is the repo-relative directory the dbt tree owns. Defaults to "dbt".

scaffold.description:
Scaffold emits a one-shot staging model per bridge object. Off by default, because the scaffold is a handover
artifact: it is written only when absent, and once written the platform neither overwrites nor deletes it.

Dbt.description: DbtJSON is the serialized form of the dbt emission block.

purpose.description: Purpose describes why this project exists.

usage.description: Usage describes how this project is intended to be used.

limitations.description: Limitations notes known constraints or caveats for this project.

Description.description: Free-text notes describing a project's intent, for readers of amfelt.yaml rather than for the engine.

enabled.description:
Enabled turns documentation emission on. Off by default: a project that omits the docs key gets no
documentation directory. Setting this back to false stops regeneration but deletes nothing already written.

path.description:
Path is the repo-relative directory the documentation tree owns outright: regeneration is a tree replace, and
a page for an object that no longer exists in the contract is deleted. Defaults to "docs".

flavor.description: Flavor selects the output conventions. Defaults to "hugo".

erdMaxObjects.description:
ERDMaxObjects caps how many objects one entity-level diagram may draw before it is replaced by a note instead
of being drawn. Defaults to 50.

Docs.description: DocsJSON is the serialized form of the documentation emission block.

name.description: Name identifies this job within the project. Must be unique among jobs.

source.description:
Source is the name of the source this job reads from. Must match the
name of an entry in the project's sources list.

target.description:
Target is the name of the target this job writes to. Must match the
name of an entry in the project's targets list.

layer.description:
Layer is the data-warehouse layer this job populates: one of "staging",
"history", "bridge", "business", or "all". Used to namespace generated
schemas/tables.

writeMode.description:
WriteMode records the intended load strategy for objects in this job's
selection: "append", "upsert" or "replace". The value is recorded but
not acted on. The staging layer always replaces (it is truncated and
reloaded on every run), so all three values land identically; how rows
accumulate across runs is decided by historyMode at the history layer.
Omitting the key is the correct authoring shape. The agent warns once
per job when the writeMode it resolves is set to anything other than
"replace"; removing the key or spelling it "replace" both silence that
warning, because both name what the staging layer already does.

schemaPrefix.description:
SchemaPrefix overrides the generated schema/dataset name prefix for
this job's objects. Defaults to the project's naming convention when empty.

maxParallel.description:
MaxParallel is the number of objects this job processes concurrently.
0 or unset runs sequentially (one object at a time); values above 1
enable concurrency, further capped by the target's connection limit.

select.description: Select is the glob-based object selection over the source contract.

runs.description: Runs are the (strategy, schedule) executions of this job's selection.

Job.description: A pipeline job: which source and target to move data between, how to select objects, and when to run.
Job.x-example-yaml:
name: crm-sync
source: crm
target: warehouse
layer: staging
select:
  include: ["public.*"]
  objects:
    public.orders:
      historyMode: scd2
      columns:
        config:
          total:
            transform: "value / 100"
            target: totalDollars
runs:
  - strategy: incremental
    schedule: "0 * * * *"

tableType.description:
TableType is the business classification of this object: one of
"master", "transaction", or "reference". It picks the default history
mode when HistoryMode is unset. Values from before the taxonomy was
reduced still load and are mapped onto it.

historyMode.description:
HistoryMode overrides the selection default for this object: one of
"scd2", "scd2_event_time", "scd1", "snapshot", "append", "dedup_append",
or "replace".

cursor.description: Cursor is the column used to detect new/changed rows for incremental loads.

cursorType.description:
CursorType says how the cursor column orders rows: "timestamp" or
"sequence". Required when cursor is set and a run is incremental; it
is never guessed.

lookback.description:
Lookback re-reads rows just behind the stored cursor on each
incremental run: a duration (e.g. "5m") for a timestamp cursor, a
non-negative integer for a sequence cursor. Defaults to "5m" for a
timestamp cursor and 0 for a sequence cursor.

deleteDetection.description:
DeleteDetection selects how deleted source rows are found: "none",
"fullRun" (a full run reconciles deletes), "keyScan" (compare the
source keys), or "softDelete" (a column marks deleted rows; needs
softDeleteColumn and softDeleteValue). Defaults to "fullRun".

softDeleteColumn.description:
SoftDeleteColumn is the column that marks a row as deleted when
deleteDetection is "softDelete".

softDeleteValue.description:
SoftDeleteValue is the value of softDeleteColumn that marks a row as
deleted when deleteDetection is "softDelete".

window.description:
Window reloads a trailing time window on each incremental run. Its
size defaults to lateArrivalThreshold.

eventTimeCol.description:
EventTimeCol is the column holding the event's business timestamp, used
for event-time ordering and late-arrival handling.

dedupKey.description:
DedupKey is the column (or comma-separated columns) that uniquely
identifies a row, used to deduplicate on load.

lateArrivalThreshold.description:
LateArrivalThreshold is the maximum delay tolerated for late-arriving
events before they are dropped or flagged, expressed as a duration
string (e.g. "24h").

columns.description:
Columns configures the extract/compare/expose glob axes and per-column
bridge-view overrides for this object.

path.description: Path of the plugin relative to the project's Amfelt directory.

address.description:
Address is the network address (host:port) of the plugin's gRPC
server. Only used when Registry is "grpc".

insecure.description:
Insecure disables TLS for the gRPC connection to this plugin. Only
used when Registry is "grpc". Default: false (TLS required).

Plugin.description: Plugin defines an Amfelt plugin configuration.

PluginManager.description: PluginManager manages the configured plugins, grouped by category.

onPatch.description:
OnPatch is the action taken for a patch-level (backward-compatible)
schema change: "stop", "warn_continue", or "adapt". Empty falls
through to the built-in floor ("warn_continue").

onMinor.description:
OnMinor is the action taken for a minor-level (additive) schema
change: "stop", "warn_continue", or "adapt". Empty falls through to
the built-in floor ("adapt").

onMajor.description:
OnMajor is the action taken for a major-level (breaking) schema
change: "stop", "warn_continue", or "adapt". Empty falls through to
the built-in floor ("stop").

overrides.description:
Overrides lists per-object/column pattern overrides, checked before
the level actions above; the first matching override wins.

Policy.description: Policy is an authorable schema-drift policy: per-semver-level actions plus object/column pattern overrides.

match.description:
Match is a glob pattern over the object name, or `"<object>.<column>"`,
that this override applies to.

onPatch.description:
OnPatch overrides the policy's patch-level action for matching
objects/columns. Unset means no override for this level.

onMinor.description:
OnMinor overrides the policy's minor-level action for matching
objects/columns. Unset means no override for this level.

onMajor.description:
OnMajor overrides the policy's major-level action for matching
objects/columns. Unset means no override for this level.

PolicyOverride.description: PolicyOverride overrides per-level actions for objects/columns matching Match (a glob over `"<object>.<column>"`).

kind.description:
Kind identifies the document as an Amfelt project file. Must be
"amfeltProject"; "infusalProject" is still accepted from files written
before the rename.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion is the PCF (project configuration file) format version this
document conforms to. Must be exactly "v0.0.0".

id.description: ID is the project's stable, unique identifier. Not meant to change once assigned.

name.description: Name is the human-readable project name shown in the UI and CLI.

version.description:
Version is the project's own version string, incremented by the
project owner as the configuration evolves.

status.description:
Status is the project's lifecycle stage: "production", "test", or
"development".

description.description: Description holds free-text purpose, usage, and limitation notes for the project.

environment.description:
Environment is the DTAP stage this project instance runs in:
"development", "test", "acceptance", or "production".

allowCrossEnvironment.description:
AllowCrossEnvironment permits sources and targets from different
environments to be combined in the same job. Default: false (disallowed).

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp the project was first created. Set once and left untouched thereafter.

maxTargetConnections.description:
MaxTargetConnections is the global ceiling on concurrent target connections
across all schemas in this project run. 0 means no project-level cap.

driftPolicy.description:
DriftPolicy is the project-level schema-drift policy. Per-source
overrides live on Source.driftPolicy; an unset level falls through to the
engine's built-in floor.

docs.description: Docs configures Markdown documentation emission into the project repository.

dbt.description: Dbt configures dbt project emission into the project repository.

sql.description: SQL configures generated-SQL emission into the project repository.

sources.description: Sources lists the data sources available to this project's jobs.

targets.description: Targets lists the data warehouse targets available to this project's jobs.

jobs.description: Jobs lists the pipeline jobs that move data from a source to a target.

transformers.description: Transformers lists the transformation jobs applied after data lands in the target.

plugins.description: Plugins lists the source, target, and transformer plugins this project depends on.

Project.description: The root of an amfelt.yaml project file: identity and metadata, the drift policy, and the sources, targets, jobs, transformers, and plugins that make up the pipeline.

role.description: Name of the IAM role that provides access to the dataset.

description.description: Description of the IAM role and its permissions.

access.description: The type of access provided by the IAM role.

firstLevelApprovers.description: The name(s) of the first-level approver(s) of the role.

secondLevelApprovers.description: The name(s) of the second-level approver(s) of the role.

Role.description: Role is an IAM role that grants access to the dataset, together with the approvers who can grant it.

name.description:
Name identifies this run within the job's Runs list. Optional when a
job has only one run.

strategy.description: Strategy is the load strategy this run executes: "full", "incremental", or "cdc".

schedule.description:
Schedule is the cron expression controlling when this run executes.
Unset means the run is triggered manually or by the job's default schedule.

Run.description: One scheduled execution of a job's selection under one strategy.
Run.x-example-yaml:
name: hourly
strategy: incremental            # full | incremental | cdc
schedule: "0 * * * *"            # cron; omit for on-demand runs

enabled.description: Enabled turns emission on. Off by default: a project that omits the sql key gets no directory.

root.description: Root is the repo-relative directory the emitted tree lives under. Defaults to "sql".

SQL.description: SQLJSON is the serialized form of the generated-SQL emission block.

name.description: Name is the schema name as it exists in the source system.

abbreviation.description:
Abbreviation is the short identifier substituted for Name in generated
schema/table names.

SchemaAbbrev.description: Maps a source schema name to its DWH abbreviation.

defaults.description:
Defaults holds selection settings applied to every matched object
unless a per-object entry in Objects overrides them.

include.description:
Include lists glob patterns for object names to select from the source
contract. Defaults to ["*"] (all objects) when empty.

exclude.description:
Exclude lists glob patterns for object names to drop from the
selection, applied after Include.

objects.description:
Objects maps an object name or glob to per-object operational
overrides (history mode, cursor, column axes, etc.).

Select.description: Glob-based selection of objects from the source contract, with optional per-object overrides.
Select.x-example-yaml:
include: ["public.*", "sales.*"]
exclude: ["public.audit_*"]
defaults:
  historyMode: scd2
objects:
  public.orders:
    tableType: transaction
    columns:
      extract:
        exclude: ["_raw_blob"]

historyMode.description:
HistoryMode is the default history-tracking mode for matched objects:
one of "scd2", "scd2_event_time", "scd1", "snapshot", "append",
"dedup_append", or "replace".

writeMode.description:
WriteMode records the intended load strategy for matched objects:
"append", "upsert" or "replace". The value is recorded but not acted
on. The staging layer always replaces, so all three values land
identically; use historyMode to control how rows accumulate across
runs. Omitting the key is the correct authoring shape. This default is
what the agent resolves first, and it warns when the resolved writeMode
is set to anything other than "replace"; removing the key or spelling
it "replace" both silence that warning.

SelectDefaults.description: Selection defaults applied to every matched object unless a per-object override sets its own value.

roles.description: List of roles that have access to the server.

path.description: Relative or absolute path to the data file(s).

port.description: Port to the server. No default value is assumed for custom servers.

warehouse.description: Name of the cluster or warehouse.

customProperties.description: A list of key/value pairs for custom properties.

Server.description: Data source details of where data is physically stored.

name.description:
Name identifies this source within the project. Must be unique among
sources and is referenced by Job.Source.

plugin.description:
Plugin is the name of the source plugin used to connect (e.g.
"postgres", "mysql"). Must match a plugin configured in Plugins.Source.

contract.description:
Contract is the path to (or name of) the data contract describing this
source's schema. Optional when objects are selected via glob instead
of an explicit contract file.

server.description:
Server describes the connection details for this source, taking
precedence over any server defined in the associated contract.
Optional for secretRef-only sources or sources that rely solely on the
contract's server.

secretRef.description: SecretRef is the vault reference path for this source's connection credentials.

abbreviation.description:
Abbreviation is the short identifier for this source in the DWH naming
convention, used as the first segment of the generated schema prefix.
Mandatory for multi-schema imports. Lowercase alphanumeric, 2-10 characters.

schemas.description:
Schemas maps source schema names to their DWH abbreviations. Populated
for multi-schema imports; empty for single-schema sources.

driftPolicy.description: DriftPolicy overrides the project-level schema-drift policy for this source.

Source.description: A connection to a source system: which plugin reads it, how it authenticates, and the contract describing its schema.
Source.x-example-yaml:
name: crm
plugin: postgres
secretRef: infisical/crm-creds   # vault reference for credentials
server:                          # non-secret connection routing
  type: postgres
  host: db.acme.io
  port: 5432
  database: crm
contract: contracts/crm.odcs.yaml

name.description:
Name identifies this target within the project. Must be unique among
targets and is referenced by Job.Target.

plugin.description:
Plugin is the name of the target plugin used to connect (e.g.
"snowflake", "postgres"). Must match a plugin configured in Plugins.Target.

server.description: Server describes the connection details for this target.

secretRef.description: SecretRef is the vault reference path for this target's connection credentials.

maxConnections.description:
MaxConnections caps the number of concurrent connections opened to
this target. 0 falls through to the plugin's default.

Target.description: A connection to a target data warehouse: which plugin writes to it, how it authenticates, and its connection limits.
Target.x-example-yaml:
name: warehouse
plugin: snowflake
secretRef: infisical/wh-creds
server:
  type: snowflake
  account: acme-prod
  database: ANALYTICS
maxConnections: 4

plugin.description:
Plugin is the name of the transformer plugin used to run these jobs
(e.g. "dbt"). Must match a plugin configured in Plugins.Transformer.

jobs.description: Jobs lists the transformation jobs this transformer runs.

Transformer.description: A transformer plugin and the jobs it runs after data has landed in a target.

name.description: Name identifies this transformer job within its transformer's Jobs list.

source.description:
Source is the name of the source this transformer job reads from.
Must match the name of an entry in the project's sources list.

target.description:
Target is the name of the target this transformer job writes to. Must
match the name of an entry in the project's targets list.

select.description: Select is the glob-based object selection this transformer job operates over.

TransformerJob.description: One transformation job: which source and target objects it transforms between, and how objects are selected.

column.description: Column is the timestamp column the window is measured on.

size.description:
Size is the window length as a duration (e.g. "24h"). Defaults to the
object's lateArrivalThreshold; without either, the window is invalid.

Window.description: Window reload settings: the rows whose column value falls inside the trailing window are read again on each incremental run.

x-example-yaml:
# A complete amfelt.yaml. Only the header (kind, apiVersion) and project
# identity (id, name, version, status) are required; every section is optional.
kind: amfeltProject
apiVersion: v0.0.0
id: 6aeafdc1-ed62-4c8f-bf0a-da1061c98cdb
name: acme-analytics
version: "1.0.0"
status: production
description:
  purpose: Load the CRM database into the analytics warehouse.
  usage: Deploy with `amfelt deploy`.
createdAt: "2026-07-05T10:00:00Z"
driftPolicy:
  onMinor: adapt   # additive source changes are adapted automatically
  onMajor: stop    # breaking source changes halt the run
sources:
  - name: crm
    plugin: postgres
    secretRef: infisical/crm-creds   # vault reference for credentials
    server:
      type: postgres
      host: db.acme.io
      port: 5432
      database: crm
    # objects are discovered by glob (see the job's select); a source may
    # instead pin an explicit ODCS contract file with `contract: <path>`.
targets:
  - name: warehouse
    plugin: snowflake
    secretRef: infisical/wh-creds
    server:
      type: snowflake
      account: acme-prod
      database: ANALYTICS
    maxConnections: 4
jobs:
  - name: crm-sync
    source: crm
    target: warehouse
    layer: staging
    select:
      include: ["public.*"]
      exclude: ["public.audit_*"]
      objects:
        public.orders:
          tableType: transaction
          historyMode: scd2
          columns:
            expose:
              include: ["order_id", "total"]
            config:
              total:
                transform: "value / 100"   # "value" = the source column
                target: totalDollars
    runs:
      - strategy: incremental
        schedule: "0 * * * *"   # hourly (cron)
plugins:
  source:
    - plugin: postgres
      version: 1.2.3
      registry: local
  target:
    - plugin: snowflake
      version: 2.0.0
      registry: local
